Describes clockwise self/counterclockwise other-person intent,inversion with saucer/cooling,and cup half facing subject as own abode versus others. Selected motifs include adhered grounds/property,three-dot line/travel,peak stain on bird/news,horse or fish/fortune,two-humped camel/wealth and white moon patch on saucer or cup bottom/favorable change. Three time units remain alternatives. This is a cultural author account,not certified prediction or a full regional grammar.

adhered_grounds.statement: The author reports a property association.

line.statement: The author reports travel after three periods,with days,months or years left alternative.

bird.statement: The author associates a stain on the peak of a bird-like figure with favorable news.

horse.statement: The author associates a horse figure with good fortune.

fish.statement: The author associates a fish figure with good fortune.

camel.statement: The author associates a double-humped camel with wealth.

moon_patch.statement: The author associates a white moon-shaped patch at the cup bottom with favorable happenings.
The author associates a white moon-shaped patch on the saucer with favorable happenings.

procedures.account: Coffee residue supplies the interpreted figures;the account distinguishes grounds from froth.
In this reported practitioner convention,clockwise stirring expresses self-reading intent;counterclockwise expresses intent for another person.
The described custom places the reversed saucer on the cup and lets it cool;finger tapping/crossing is optional.
After favorable prospects and completion,the described belief calls for keeping the cup upright;no physical causality asserted.
The author describes stuck residue as an exception calling for no reading,with wish attainment as a belief;the preceding fictional scene is separate.

editorial_conventions: Manual identities and attributes are user declarations,never observations by this software. Input order and raw text retained.
Request vessel is an explicit default for its observations;an observation may explicitly override it for mixed cup/saucer readings.
Cup-only scope for non-moon motifs follows the narrative about figures inside the cup;unmentioned saucer motifs are unsupported,not negative predictions.
Literal English peak is retained;no automatic correction to beak or equivalence inferred from raw notes.
A scalar or bounded list declares attribute evidence;contradictory known alternatives yield conflict,unknown or ambiguous evidence remains insufficient.
Rotation and half orientation are separate;no handle axis,rim/depth timing,angle thresholds,adjacency or Kent defaults.

Optional preparation declarations neither prove physical preparation nor gate symbolic comparisons. The stuck-cup exception is documentary only,not an automatic suppression of a voluntary hypothetical comparison.
